metas.name: The L Word
metas.description: A group of lesbian friends struggle with romance and careers in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Empire
metas.description: A powerful family drama about the head of a music empire whose three sons and ex-wife all battle for his throne.

metas.name: Dynasty
metas.description: Follows two of America’s wealthiest families, the Carringtons and the Colbys, as they feud for control over their fortune and their children focusing on Fallon Carrington, the daughter of billionaire Blake Carrington, and her soon-to-be stepmother, Cristal, a Hispanic woman marrying into this WASP family and America’s most powerful class.
